title: AX56 Bring-up
profTagline: Watch a Wi-Fi 6 chip boot from cold to firmware, register by register
installDesc: Add to your home screen for a full-screen bring-up.
installIosHint: Tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
installGenericHint: Open the browser menu and choose Install.
connectBody: Connect an RTL8852AU already in Wi-Fi mode, such as the ASUS USB-AX56, to read its live registers. Switching it out of storage mode needs the userspace driver — a browser cannot do that part.
noUsb: This browser has no WebUSB. Open in Chrome on Android or desktop, or watch the demo.
